headline: Hungary’s central bank may add climate risk scenarios to policy framework
summary: Hungary's central bank is considering adding climate risk scenarios to its policy framework, Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali said. He warned that drought and a likely rebound in global food prices could push up inflation next year.
why: Central bank frameworks guide interest rate decisions and inflation expectations. Adding climate scenarios would affect how the bank assesses future price risks.
